scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flight-route-explorer/web exec vite build && pnpm --filter '!@flight-route-explorer/web' --recursive --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --showConfig --project tsconfig.base.json > /dev/null && pnpm --filter '!@flight-route-explorer/web' --recursive --if-present run typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:config && pnpm run validate:policy && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:offline && pnpm run container:smoke
